findings.evidence: The roadmap names only `powerSubgroup` and `powerClassQuotient` at Suggested.lean:2317–2324; `rg` finds `PowerClassGroup`, `powerClassAdd`, and the associated lemmas only in this new file, whereas `kummerClassMap` at Kummer.lean:286–289 has domain `powerClassQuotient Kˣ n`.
findings.fix: Remove the additive `ModN` model and its parallel API from this PR, retaining `powerSubgroup`, `powerClassQuotient`, `powerClassHom`, its kernel/membership characterization, and the quotient lift API.
findings.issue: `PowerClassGroup` and its public API (`powerClassAdd`, `powerClass`, and lines 119–186) duplicate the canonical `powerClassQuotient`/`powerClassHom` surface through `ModN`; no in-repository consumer uses this model, while `Kummer.lean` uses only the multiplicative quotient.

summary: The PR exposes a second, unused additive power-class API alongside the canonical multiplicative quotient required by the roadmap.
